hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In this dimly lit tavern, hidden in the shadows, I, Betty, was caught. The candle flickered as I loosened my stays with the heavy laundry tubs. My heart raced as I pondered what secrets lay in those shadows. Was it curiosity? Or was it something more? Join me as I unravel the mystery of 18th-century London's hidden desires!
caption:
Caught in the quiet of the tavern, a new maid’s true secrets come to light!
